gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.
'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.
